create_fcc_crystal_by_num_atoms: create a random FCC crystal structure with a specified number of atoms and lattice constant
create_fcc_crystal_by_num_cells: create an FCC crystal supercell by specifying the number of unit cells in each dimension
create_water_box: create a periodic box of randomly positioned water molecules with a given seed
create_slab_adsorbate: create an FCC(111) slab with an adsorbed molecule, OC20-style tags, and FixAtoms constraints
build_molecular_dynamics_initial_structu: build an initial atomic structure for molecular dynamics using FCC crystals or water boxes
